figures.caption: Figure 1: Protocol ceilings, not model training curves. In (a), exact state-channel ceilings and Monte Carlo estimates show that same-time replication rapidly saturates while dispersed occasions continue to add temporal information. In (b), stable traits create nonzero long-horizon snapshot ceilings; dotted lines are the T → ∞ limits.
Figure 2: The label defines temporal information. Both kernels in panel (a) have τ1 = 1; panel (b) uses an OU window with w/τ1 = 0.5.
